scenario: LOPQ.2.3 / 3.1 — an opaque value may be equality-compared only to a value of the SAME opaque type. Comparing two distinct opaque types is DS_VALIDATE_OPAQUE_TYPE_MISMATCH.
rules_ds:
opaque type Key       over Bytes
opaque type Signature over Bytes

schema A scope logical:
    k: Key key
    s: Signature mutable

rule r:
    A a where a.k == a.s
->
    log info "x"
